_note: Cinefoundry casting library. Every voice is designed from its written description with Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign - nobody's recording. scripts/voice-design.py makes the takes, scripts/voice-qc.py scores them (Whisper pronunciation, pitch against gender and age, level) and keeps the best as <voices dir>/<id>.wav. Adults only. Agents cast by language, use, gender and age.

referenceText.English: Light falls across the table. Some things don't need to be said out loud. When time slows down, you hear it, and you remember it.
referenceText.Chinese: 光，落在桌面上。有些东西，不必大声说出来。时间慢下来的时候，你会听见它，也会记住它。
